output.reason: The linked PR says that in v2, namespace-scoped XRs may no longer compose cluster-scoped resources, because Kubernetes does not let a namespaced owner own a cluster-scoped resource. Crossplane now checks each composed resource after it is rendered and before it is applied [ev-560f3cbdb259]. That covers applicability: the check runs only when the XR is namespaced and the rendered composed resource has no namespace set. It is skipped for cluster-scoped XRs and for resources that have a namespace [ev-560f3cbdb259][ev-a1a7b86561c9]. That covers consequence too: the XR enters a ReconcileError condition with a "cannot compose resources: …" message instead of the resource being applied [ev-a1a7b86561c9], and the changed files show this is done in the composition-functions reconciler [ev-5c55174e71ee].
